facts.fact: The Competition and Fair Trading Commission invited comments by 28 July 2025 on a draft Consumer Protection Bill and draft Complaints Management Mechanism Regulations, prepared under the AfDF-funded project to improve access to digital financial services; the notice describes a general consumer framework and does not name digital financial services rules.
facts.system: Draft Consumer Protection Bill and Complaints Management Mechanism Regulations

note: Scope for digital financial services not stated; no body for such complaints or enforcement stated.
